intro: Lesson 16. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا (١١) وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا (١٢) وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا (١٣) وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا (١٤) ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ (١٥) كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا (١٦) سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا (١٧) إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ (١٨) فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ (١٩) ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ (٢٠)

ثُمَّ نَظَرَ (٢١) ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ (٢٢) ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ (٢٣) فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ (٢٤) إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ (٢٥) سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ (٢٦) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ (٢٧) لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ (٢٨) لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ (٢٩) عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ (٣٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Leave Me with the one I created alone And to whom I granted extensive wealth And children present [with him]
And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life]. Then he desires that I should add more. No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
I will cover him with arduous torment. Indeed, he thought and deliberated. So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated. Then he considered [again]; Then he frowned and scowled;
Then he turned back and was arrogant And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others]. This is not but the word of a human being."
I will drive him into Saqar. And what can make you know what is Saqar? It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
Blackening the skins. Over it are nineteen [angels].

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Muddaththir 74:11-30 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 74:11-30 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 74:11-30 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, list the steps in 74:18 to 23 that led him to reject the truth.
questions.a: He thought, plotted, looked, frowned, scowled, turned back and was arrogant.

questions.q: Plan your week: how will you memorise 20 ayat in sections? Write it in the log.
questions.a: For example: 74:11 to 15 Mon, 16 to 20 Tue, 21 to 25 Wed, 26 to 30 Thu, link Fri.

questions.q: What did the man call the Qur'an (74:24)?
questions.a: A) Magic. 74:24: 'This is not but magic imitated'.

questions.q: Al-Muddaththir 74:25: «إِنْ هَٰذَآ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: A man was given wealth and sons, then heard the Qur'an and called it 'magic'. Why might people reject the truth even when they know it?
questions.a: Pride and love of status: he thought, plotted, frowned, turned away in arrogance (74:18 to 23).
